parts.latex: During a storm, 25 mm of rain fell on this block of land. Calculate the volume of water, giving your answer in litres.

Greg plans to drive from Sydney to Newcastle and can choose between two routes:

\begin{itemize}
\item Route A would take 1 hour and 55 minutes at an average speed of 85 km/h.
\item Route B would take 2 hours and 10 minutes at an average speed of 74 km/h.
\end{itemize}

Greg’s car has a fuel consumption rate of 9.3 L/100 km.

What is the minimum amount of fuel Greg could use to complete this trip?

solutions.latex:
$4$ pages $= 24$ min, so $1$ page $= 6$ min.

$\therefore$ $7$ pages $= 42$ minutes.

$600$ mL in $2$ hrs $= 600$ mL in $120$ min

$1200$ drops in $120$ min

$\therefore$ $100$ drops in $1$ min, i.e. $100$ drops/min.
$D F E A B C D E B$

$250\text{ mL} : 85\text{ g} = 250\text{ mL} : 0.085\text{ kg}$

$\times 120$: $30\,000\text{ mL} : 10.2\text{ kg}$, i.e. $30$ L for $10.2$ kg.

$\therefore 3 \times 8 = 24$ min.

Route A: $D = 85 \times 1\frac{55}{60} = 162.92$ km

Route B: $D = 74 \times 2\frac{10}{60} = 160.33$ km

$\therefore$ Route B.

Fuel $= \dfrac{160.33 \times 9.3}{100} = 14.91$ L

notes: Bundled solutions (pages 12-23) are a handwritten 'Version 1' of the test whose Section I differs from the printed paper (the question pages 1-7 are Version 2): different option order in Q1-3, Q4 is 26->20 year old at 70% in V1 vs 20 year old at 60% in the paper, Q5 option order differs. So V1 circled answers were NOT used for Q1-5. MCQ key for the printed paper is read from the Version 2 answer sheet (page 23, crossed ovals: 1 B, 2 D, 3 C, 4 A, 5 A) and checked by working (Q1 B is the only tree; Q2 P-Q-R-S is the only path; Q3 250 g is cheapest per gram; Q4 0.6 x 200 = 120; Q5 A: president joined to all five, each other member has two regular neighbours). The Version 1 answer sheet (page 21) disagrees with the V1 circled answers for Q2 and Q4, so it was ignored. No worked solutions for MCQ 1-5 in the file (coverage step to generate). Printed typos: cover and Section II header say 'Questions 6-15' but the section has Questions 6-16; Q11 'dissolve this these of crystals'; cover says MCQ sheet is on page 11 but it is on page 9. Question 4 is the Section II header on the page but is multiple choice and counts toward the 5 MCQ marks (Section I marks listed as Questions 1-5); section is set to II as printed on the page layout (the paper's 'End of Section I' falls before Q4). Section II mark sum for Q6-16 = 30. Q10 part ii has sub-parts (alpha) and (beta); part ii itself carries no marks. Handwritten solution Q16 shows Route A distance as 165.91 km; the correct value 85 x 1 55/60 = 162.92 km is written in the solution here (conclusion Route B, 14.91 L unchanged). Handwritten Q15(ii) labels 25.2 as m^2; written as m^3. Reference sheet (page 11) skipped. Q4 and Q5 sit under the Section II heading in the layout but the cover says Section I = Questions 1-5, so their section may be corrected to I downstream.
